content: LLM caching for per-tenant SaaS: (1) Per-tenant, per-day cache key is standard — key = hash(org_id + date + input_context_hash); (2) Anthropic prompt caching: cache writes cost 1.25x, reads cost 0.1x (90% discount), 5-min TTL default extended to 1h with regular hits, min 1024 tokens; (3) Cache hit rates of 70-84% reported in production after tuning TTL and breakpoints; (4) For analytics summaries: cache the full LLM response in a DB table (org_id, cache_date, context_hash, response_text, model_used, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, cached_at); (5) Stale check: re-generate if underlying insight count changed significantly (delta > 2 insights) or if cache is older than 24h; (6) Security: per-tenant cache isolation required — never serve cache from one org to another.
